metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins for code review, predictive agent workflows, and development harness tooling.

plugins.name: code-review-annotator
plugins.description: Inline code review with MCP integration — add comments in the browser via SSH port forward, let Claude Code read and fix them via MCP tools.

plugins.name: predictive-mind
plugins.description: FEP/World-Models scaffolding for stable LLM coding agents: predict-before-act, inspectable belief state, and surprise-triggered reflection.

plugins.name: harness-toolkit
plugins.description: Developer toolkit for auditing harness maturity (L0-L4), setting up AGENTS.md, configuring linters, hooks, CI, and skill creation workflows.
